fusions.name: First Look
fusions.desc: A darting bite at the first enemy in a line up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not yet been wounded. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Seen Weakness
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more for each one. It leaves the target 5% easier to wound and [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fixed Gaze
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spotted Mark
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
